claims.claim: For absences of 7 days or fewer, self-certification is used as evidence of sickness.
claims.quote: If employees are off work for 7 days or less, they do not need to give their employer a fit note or other proof of sickness from a healthcare professional.
claims.note: The text says absences of 7 days or less need no fit note and the employee confirms sickness themselves, called self-certification.
